correctness.rationale: Proof independently reconstructed for all finite real positive margins: maxima of each table entry are exactly min(row,column); containing reflection about a candidate center is coordinatewise because the defining equalities are preserved. Feasibility of its lower bound is necessary by row/column sums and sufficient by a rank-one residual transportation table. This proves sharp beta, all centers and dimension using interior positive residual table; min-margin and square invariance follow analytically. Exact rational verifier checks 648 instances, independent LP comparisons 45; finite checks are not infinite proof.
